Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 30, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how ASND collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects personal information when you use the service. ASND is currently an unincorporated project operated by Aryan Irani. This Privacy Policy applies to ASND's website, applications, waitlists, applications, profiles, discovery tools, messaging, beta programs, and related services.

1. Information we collect

The information we collect depends on how you use ASND.

Information you provide directly
We may collect name; email address; phone number; location; account role; login information; profile photograph; professional information; skills, disciplines, niches, and specialties; availability; payment preferences; portfolio and website links; social media links; work samples; past clients and collaborations; brand or agency information; application answers; brief and opportunity information; messages sent through ASND; and feedback and support requests.

2. Creator application information

Creator applications may include portfolio information, professional history, previous clients, work samples, references or vouches, and contact information for people who may be able to vouch for the applicant.
Creator applications are reviewed by people.
ASND does not use artificial intelligence as the final decision-maker for creator vetting.

3. Reference information

If an applicant provides another person's name, email address, or phone number as a possible reference or vouch, we may use that information to determine whether that person is already part of ASND, contact them to confirm whether they know the applicant, and support the applicant's vetting process.
Users should only provide reference information where they reasonably believe the person would expect to be contacted for this purpose.

4. Brand and agency information

We may collect company or agency name, work email, website, social media or other verifying links, industry or specialty, campaign history, creative needs, briefs, links to creators who hold their own ASND profiles and have agreed to the link, past work, and clients on whose behalf briefs are posted.
Agency applications are reviewed by people. ASND does not use artificial intelligence as the final decision-maker for agency verification.
If an agency provides the name, email address, or phone number of a client or creator who can confirm the relationship, we may use it as described in Section 3 (Reference information). ASND does not collect or display roster information about creators who do not have their own ASND profile.

5. Information collected automatically

When you use ASND, we may automatically collect information such as IP address, device type, browser, operating system, pages or screens viewed, interactions with features, referring pages, approximate location derived from IP address, dates and times of use, and error and diagnostic information.
We may use cookies, local storage, or similar technologies for these purposes.

6. How we use information

We may use personal information to create and manage accounts, process applications, conduct human vetting, verify users, operate profiles and discovery, provide search and filtering, recommend potentially relevant profiles or opportunities, enable briefs and responses, facilitate connections, provide messaging, communicate service updates, provide customer support, detect fraud and misuse, enforce ASND's Terms, maintain security, understand how ASND is used, improve user experience, test new features, and comply with legal obligations.
ASND may use automated tools or artificial intelligence to assist with search, filtering, classification, ranking, or product operations.
ASND does not use AI to independently decide whether a creator passes human vetting.

7. Information visible to other users

Some information is intended to be visible to other eligible ASND users.
This may include name, photograph, discipline, niche, location, availability, work samples, portfolio, professional history, past collaborations, associated brands, agency information, links between agencies and creators who hold their own ASND profiles, and clients named on briefs.
We will not intentionally display private contact details publicly unless the feature clearly indicates that the information will be visible

8. How we share information

With other ASND users
Information may be shared when necessary for profile discovery, brief responses, references, connections, messaging, and collaboration.

With service providers
We may use third-party providers for cloud hosting, databases, authentication, email, analytics, security, customer support, payments, artificial intelligence services, and infrastructure. These providers may process information on our behalf only as needed to provide their services.

For legal and safety reasons
We may disclose information where reasonably necessary to comply with law, respond to lawful requests, protect users, investigate fraud or abuse, enforce our agreements, and protect ASND's rights or property.

Business transfers
If ASND later becomes part of a company, investment, acquisition, merger, restructuring, or asset transfer, information may be transferred as part of that transaction where permitted by law.

9. Sale and sharing of personal information

ASND does not sell personal information for money.
ASND does not intend to sell user profiles, contact information, application information, or portfolio data to data brokers.
Some privacy laws define "sale" or "sharing" more broadly, particularly where advertising technologies are involved.
If ASND later uses technologies that legally constitute sale or sharing, we will provide any notices and opt-out mechanisms required by law.

10. Cookies and analytics

ASND may use cookies and similar technologies to keep users signed in, remember preferences, maintain security, understand platform use, diagnose errors, and measure performance.
Where required by law, ASND will request consent before using non-essential cookies.
Users may also control cookies through their browser settings.

11. Search, matching, and recommendations

ASND may process profile and opportunity information to help users identify relevant collaborators.
Factors may include discipline, niche, style, availability, location, industry experience, preferred collaboration type, and past collaborations.
These tools support discovery.
They do not guarantee suitability, employment, performance, or successful collaboration.

12. Vetting

Creator vetting is conducted through human review.
Agency verification is also conducted through human review.
Different creative categories may require different forms of evaluation. Information used for vetting may include portfolio materials, work samples, professional history, verifying information, and references or vouches.
Automated systems may support administrative tasks but do not make the final creative-quality decision.

13. Data retention

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy. This may include providing the service, maintaining accounts, resolving disputes, preventing fraud, maintaining security, and complying with legal obligations.

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information.
Deactivating an account may hide the profile and stop normal use without immediately deleting all associated information.
Limited records may be retained after deactivation where reasonably necessary for legal compliance, security, fraud prevention, or recordkeeping.

14. Security

ASND uses reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal information.
No digital system can guarantee absolute security.
Users are responsible for protecting their login credentials and should notify ASND if they believe their account has been compromised.

15. Your privacy rights

Depending on where you live and which laws apply, you may have rights concerning your personal information. These may include the right to request access to personal information, request correction of inaccurate information, request deletion, withdraw consent where processing relies on consent, object to or restrict certain processing, receive information about how your data is used, opt out of certain sale or sharing practices, appeal certain privacy decisions, and complain to an appropriate regulator.
Not every right applies in every jurisdiction.
We may need to verify your identity before completing a request.
To submit a privacy request, contact: ai3926@rit.edu

16. New York residents

ASND is operated from New York. Where New York law applies to ASND and your information, including laws on data security and breach notification, ASND will handle your personal information in accordance with those laws. New York residents may contact ASND using the details in Section 24 with questions or requests about their personal information, and ASND will respond as required by applicable law.
ASND does not currently intend to sell personal information.

17. Users in India

ASND may process personal data relating to users in India.
Where Indian privacy law applies to ASND, we will process personal data in accordance with applicable legal requirements.
This may include providing notice about what personal data is collected, why it is collected, how it is used, how users may exercise applicable rights, and how users may contact ASND regarding privacy concerns.
Where consent is required, users may withdraw consent subject to applicable law and legitimate retention obligations.

18. International data processing

ASND may serve users in multiple countries.
Information may therefore be processed or stored outside the country where a user lives.
Where required by law, ASND will use appropriate safeguards for international data transfers.

19. Children's privacy

ASND is intended for people aged 18 and older.
We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18 through normal account registration.
If we learn that information was collected from a child in violation of applicable law, we will take reasonable steps to delete it.

20. Third-party links

ASND profiles may contain links to websites, portfolios, social media platforms, and external services.
ASND is not responsible for the privacy practices of those third parties.
Users should review external privacy policies before providing information to those services.

21. Communications

We may send service-related communications such as account notifications, application updates, opportunity notifications, security notices, and platform updates.
Where permitted, we may also send marketing communications.
Users can unsubscribe from promotional communications using the method provided in those messages.
Certain account and security communications may still be required while an account remains active.

22. Account deactivation and deletion

Where available, users may deactivate their ASND account.
Deactivation may remove the profile from normal discovery, stop certain notifications, and prevent normal account activity.
Deactivation is not necessarily the same as permanent deletion.
Users may contact ASND to request deletion where applicable law provides that right.

23. Changes to this Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy as ASND evolves or legal requirements change.
The effective date will be updated when changes are made.
If changes materially affect how personal information is used, we will provide additional notice where required by law.

24. Contact

Questions, concerns, or privacy requests may be sent to:
ASND
Operated by Aryan Irani
Rochester, New York, United States
Privacy email: ai3926@rit.edu
General contact: ai3926@rit.edu
